 Black Friday prices are officially live on Apple Watches, AirTags, MacBooks and more
 By Rikka Altland , CNN Underscored
 Published
 9:31 AM EST, Thu November 19, 2026
 Link Copied!
 Rikka Altland/CNN Underscored 
 What's in this guide 
 AirPods deals 
 MacBook deals 
 AirTags deals 
 Apple Watch deals 
 iPad deals 
 Apple accessory deals 
 Beats deals 
 Why these deals are worth shopping 
 Why trust CNN Underscored 
 Black Friday is one of the best times of year to shop for Apple products. It doesn’t matter which corner of the brand’s lineup you’re hoping to score a discount on, you’ll find some of the year’s lowest prices across its latest AirPods, AirTag trackers, MacBooks, rugged Apple Watches and official accessories. Even better, you don’t have to wait until Thanksgiving week officially rolls around in order to save.
 Ahead, you’ll find the best early Black Friday sales on 30 of the company’s most popular products, many of which have been tested time and time again by CNN Underscored experts. Over the course of my years writing about Apple for a living, I’ve used just about every product in this guide myself. As for the devices and accessories I personally haven’t yet had the chance to test, my colleagues have taken the time to vet them.
 Early Black Friday AirPods deals
 Editor Favorite 
 Apple AirPods Pro 3 
 Amazon 
 If you have an iPhone, an iPad or a Mac, there's only one answer to which pair of earbuds you should buy: the AirPods Pro 3. Like for many other CNN Underscored editors, these are my personal-favorite earbuds due to their superb sound quality, all-day battery life, comfortable fit and reliable active noise cancellation (ANC) that helps block out my surroundings when it comes time to focus. Apple's best AirPods aren't down to their lowest price of the year, but you can still score some savings — $50 off — if you want to get your hands on them ahead of Black Friday.
 Read our review 
 $249 
 $179 at Amazon
 Apple AirPods Max 2 
 Apple 
 Every time I go on a trip with my wife, she ends up taking my pair of AirPods Max 2. It makes sense, after all, because they offer some of the best ANC money can buy, which comes in handy to block out the sound of whirling engines, chatty seatmates and crying babies on flights. She may not write about headphones for a living as I do, but even she recognizes just how good Apple's higher-end headphones are. Features new to this second-gen model, including Conversation Awareness and Live Translation, make today's $100 discount especially notable.
 Read our review 
 $549 
 From $429 at Amazon
 Apple EarPods With Lightning Connector 
 Amazon 
 Wired earbuds are more than just a trendy way to listen to music. If you're not interested in having to remember to charge your earbuds, sticking with a pair that includes a Lightning connector means you can plug these EarPods right into the charging port on your iPhone 14 or older for instant access to music, podcasts and phone calls.
 $19 
 $15 at Amazon
 Early Black Friday MacBook deals
 First-Time Deal 
 Apple MacBook Neo 512GB 
 Apple 
 Apple's new MacBook Neo has been the talk of the town since it was released at the beginning of the year. Surely a laptop this cheap can't actually be worth recommending, right? We put it to the test to find out, and were shocked by just how good of a value this is. While there have been a few random discounts at Amazon over the past few months that take anywhere from $5 to $10 off the usual price, the first real markdown has arrived with a $50 discount on the best budget computer you can buy. 
 Read our review 
 $699 
 $649 at Amazon
 Rare Deal 
 Apple 13-Inch MacBook Air M5 in Midnight 
 Amazon 
 The newest MacBook Air and its MSRP have had a complicated year. Apple raised its price over the summer, and since then, retailers haven't offered many chances to save. As Black Friday looms, I'd take any discount as a sign things are evening out with the best MacBook our editors have tested and its speedy M5 processor. Today's $250 discount will likely be the best offer we see through the next few weeks.
 $1,299 
 $1,049 at Amazon
 Apple 15-Inch MacBook Air M5 
 Amazon 
 The 15-inch version of the MacBook Air is also $250 off this week. Today's markdown is an extra $50 below the previous sale price, and matches the steepest discount to date. It has the same M5 performance, all-day battery life and go-anywhere design as its smaller counterpart, just with a larger screen that's more appropriate for those who take full advantage of the device's multitasking capabilities.
 $1,499 
 From $1,249 at Amazon
 Apple 14-Inch MacBook Pro M5 
 Amazon 
 For anyone who needs a more capable computer to match the increased demands of their workload, the MacBook Pro is the laptop for you. Not everyone needs the performance boost that helps with editing photos or videos that this laptop offers, but for those who do, today's discount helps you save $200. It's also an extra $40 below the previous markdown on its gorgeous 14-inch Liquid Retina XDR Display that's larger and more vibrant than what you'll find on Apple's other devices.
 $1,999 
 $1,799 at Amazon
 Early Black Friday AirTags deals
 Lowest Price 
 Apple AirTag (2nd Gen) 
 Amazon 
 There's never been a better time to buy Apple's newest Bluetooth trackers . Holiday travel season is on the horizon, and that will likely mean you have more to worry about than the location of your luggage. Now an extra $1 below any other markdown in the past, the new and improved AirTag 2 can track items with a longer range and help you locate them with a louder speaker volume than the original. Both of these adjustments make the $6 discount an even better buy for adding some extra peace of mind to the hectic holiday season.
 Read our review 
 $29 
 $23 at Amazon
 Apple AirTags (2nd Gen), 4-Pack 
 Amazon 
 While it's not an entirely new low price, as with a single AirTag, this four-pack of Apple's latest luggage trackers has returned to its best discount to date. It's an even better value for those who were thinking about scoring more than a single item finder, dropping the price of each down to $20.
 Read our review 
 $99 
 $80 at Amazon
 Early Black Friday Apple Watch deals
 Apple Watch Series 12 
 Amazon 
 A new low price has just landed on the new Apple Watch Series 12. The company's latest smartwatch was just released this fall with redesigned sensors that make it the most accurate fitness tracker that Apple has released, and ahead of Black Friday, both sizes have received $70 discounts. Today's offer makes now the perfect time to try out the best smartwatch around and all its new tricks as it lands at a new low price that's $20 under its previous markdown during Amazon's October Prime Day event.
 Read our review 
 $399 
 From $329 at Amazon
 Apple Watch SE (3rd Gen) 
 Apple 
 Even though new smartwatches from the brand have been released, the Apple Watch SE 3 is still one of the best values across Apple's line of fitness trackers . In fact, it offers much of the same health monitoring tech as the higher-end smartwatches, despite its lower price tag. It hasn't been on sale many times throughout 2026, but for Black Friday, you can save $50 with the year's best discount.
 Read our review 
 $249 
 From $199 at Amazon
 Apple Watch Sport Loop Band (46mm) 
 Amazon 
 While there are a few different ways you can customize either of the Apple Watch models on sale this week, none of them come with one of Apple's official Sport Loop bands. Luckily, Amazon is marking down several styles of the 46mm watch band to their lowest prices yet. The Ultramarine color is the best offer among them at 41% off, but you can also save on some other designs of the fabric strap with its hook-and-loop fastener.
 $49 
 From $29 at Amazon
 Apple Watch Sport Band (40mm) 
 Amazon 
 It's rare to find deals on official Apple Watch bands , but ahead of Black Friday, you can save on quite a few colors at Amazon. If you're not planning to upgrade from an older version of the Apple Watch anytime soon, this strap will fit with any 40mm smartwatch from the company. Some deals are already present on their product pages, while others only apply after you've clipped the on-page coupon.
 $59 
 From $32 at Amazon
 Early Black Friday iPad deals
 Best Tested 
 Apple iPad (11th Gen) 
 Amazon 
 If you're hoping to put the most affordable iPad in Apple's collection under the tree this year, it might be worth taking advantage of this $50 discount before it's too late. During previous savings events this like, the 11th-generation iPad was one of the few Apple products to actually sell out before those sales came to an end. I doubt it will drop much lower than this markdown either, making today's discount an opportunity to score one of the best values around from Apple (and our pick for the overall best iPad ) for less.
 $449 
 $399 at Amazon
 Apple 11-Inch iPad Air M4 
 Amazon 
 Looking for an iPad that can actually replace your laptop? The newest iPad Air is exactly what you're searching for. After trying the new tablet himself, CNN Underscored senior tech editor Mike Andronico loved that it came with a performance boost that ensures you'll be able to use it for years to come. Depending on the color you choose, you can save as much as $99.
 $749 
 $650 at Amazon
 Apple 13-Inch iPad Air M4 
 Amazon 
 You can save $99 on the larger iPad Air M4 in addition to the 11-inch model. It delivers the same performance as its smaller counterpart, just with a larger 13-inch Liquid Retina display. That allows you to take full advantage of its improved multitasking features Andronico noted in his review, as well as the M4 processor's ability to run several apps at once.
 Read our review 
 $949 
 From $850 at Amazon
 Apple iPad Mini (2024) 
 Apple 
 Apple may have just released a new iPad Mini , but the 2026 version's biggest issue is its expensive price tag. If you'r not ready to pay nearly $700 for our favorite small tablet, the previous-generation model is now $200 less with today's $100 discount. Its compact design is still every bit as ideal for reading e-bikes and playing games, and today, you can snag it for $20 shy of its lowest price.
 Read our review 
 $599 
 $499 at Amazon
 Apple Pencil Pro 
 Apple 
 One of the best reasons to have an iPad? Using it as a digital notebook. The Apple Pencil Pro fully enables that functionality, turning supported tablets into one of the most capable digital writing and drawing experiences across nearly any other device on the market. During testing, our tech editors were impressed by the new dial menu features that made it easier than ever to write and draw. After digging into the pricing history, I doubt this $30 discount will be beaten come Black Friday.
 Read our review 
 $129 
 $99 at Amazon
 Apple USB-C Pencil 
 Amazon 
 The basic USB-C Apple Pencil is also on sale this week, offering much of the same digital writing experience for less than its more expensive Pro counterpart. It doesn't have the exact same bells and whistles, but it will get the job done for taking notes or sketching little doodles.
 $79 
 $70 at Amazon
 Early Black Friday Apple accessory deals
 Anker Nano 45W USB-C Wall Charger 
 Amazon 
 It may not be an official iPhone accessory, but the best USB-C wall charger I've used is sold by Anker, not Apple. It matches the best price to date at $14 — for only the second time — for those with a Prime membership, and it comes in four colors. My favorite part is that the Anker Nano 45W uses smart charging tech that can protect your smartphone's battery against overheating and extend its lifespan.
 $40 
 $26 at Amazon
 $40 
 $26 at Anker
 Apple 35W Dual USB-C Compact Power Adapter 
 Apple 
 Those who'd prefer an official Apple wall adapter should look to this model that can charge two devices at once thanks to a pair of USB-C ports and 35 watts of power. It's just as capable of topping off your smartphone as it is at charging your iPad overnight. I also love that its design is compact enough to stow in a work bag or carry-on or to use at home behind a nightstand because of its downward-facing ports.
 $59 
 $39 at Amazon
 Apple 2-Meter Wireless MagSafe Charger 
 Amazon 
 The latest version of Apple's MagSafe wireless charger is practically a must for everyone with an iPhone 12 or newer, especially if you haven't already invested in a wireless charger stand. Its 2-meter cord means you have plenty of space between your wall outlet and your phone, and we noticed fairly fast charging speeds in our testing.
 Read our review 
 $39 
 $31 at Amazon
 Lowest Price 
 Apple iPhone 18 Pro/Max Silicone Case 
 Apple 
 Apple's official silicone case offers one of the best ways to protect your smartphone, and that continues to be the case with its iPhone 18 Pro offerings. While many of the company's in-house accessories are on sale this week, the silicone case is my personal favorite, with a soft-touch finish and tons of colors to choose from. Right now, you can score it for up to 41% off.
 $49 
 From $29 at Amazon
 Apple iPhone 18 Pro Clear Case 
 Apple 
 If you're keen on covering your smartphone in a clear case, Apple makes the best ones. They don't yellow over time, and they're perfect for protecting your device without adding extra bulk or covering up the color of the iPhone you specifically chose. I also love to use them when I want to personalize my device by putting a Polaroid photo or even a Pokémon card on the back of my device. Several of the MagSafe-compatible cases are on sale for each of Apple's previous-generation smartphones.
 $49 
 $39 at Amazon
 Apple Crossbody Strap 
 Amazon 
 Apple's official crossbody phone strap is now up to 61% off across several colors. These accessories are a great way to keep your smartphone within arm's reach without having to stow it in your pocket or purse. Unlike alternatives, Apple uses magnetic fasteners that allow you to dial in the perfect length. 
 $59 
 From $23 at Amazon
 Apple Wrist Strap 
 Amazon 
 To complement its crossbody lanyard, Apple also recently released a Wrist Strap to help prevent accidental drops while carrying your iPhone around. It's compatible with many of the cases that are included in the early Black Friday deals this week, and it's on sale for the first time across several colors.
 $30 
 From $23 at Amazon
 Early Black Friday Beats deals
 First-Time Deal 
 Beats 360 Over-Ear Headphones 
 Apple 
 Over-ear headphones aren't often considered the most ideal gym companion, but the Beats 360 attempt to disrupt that thinking. The newest headphones from Beats are the brand's first sweat-resistant over-ear headphones, and now for Black Friday, they're on sale for the first time, with $101 off black and off-white Cloud colors at Amazon.
 $350 
 From $249 at Amazon
 Beats Solo 4 Over-Ear Headphones 
 Beats 
 If the AirPods Max are too pricey for what you're looking to spend on a pair of headphones, this over-ear alternative from Beats is the next best thing for those on a budget. At the usual $200 MSRP, these are already a fraction of the price of Apple's higher-end pair, but the Solo 4 still deliver many of the same features for those who use an iPhone, an iPad or a Mac. Several colors are $100 off at Amazon now that official Black Friday deals have arrived.
 Read our review 
 $200 
 $100 at Amazon
 Beats Studio Pro Over-Ear Headphones 
 Beats 
 These Beats headphones sound better than the Solo 4 that are also on sale this week for those willing to spend a little extra. Whether you own an iPhone or an Android smartphone, you'll be able to enjoy the superb noise cancellation, rich audio and all-day battery life offered by the Beats Studio Pro.
 Read our review 
 $300 
 $150 at Amazon
 Beats Flex 
 Amazon 
 These affordable semi-corded earbuds offer a no-frills solution to the workout-buds problem. I love that the Flex have handy inline controls for switching songs or adjusting volume without having to reach for your smartphone, and they're available in four colors, all of which are currently $20 off.
 Read our review 
 $70 
 $50 at Amazon
 Why these Apple deals are worth shopping
 I’m constantly tracking price cuts across multiple online storefronts to ensure the tech deals are as good as retailers say. The rest of the deals team and I dive into each product’s price history while cross-referencing reviews and guides from other CNN Underscored editors to determine if it’s worth your cash.
 Why trust CNN Underscored
 CNN Underscored’s deals editors scour the internet daily for the best available sales and discounts, then put them on your radar in real time. They utilize a range of techniques and consider a variety of factors — price history checks, available coupon codes, competitor pricing — to determine if a deal is worthy of coverage (and your money).
 For this article, CNN Underscored senior deals editor Rikka Altland took a closer look at Apple’s lineup of devices to find the ones truly on sale and actually worth shopping.
